rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Pick the areas to protect. Each one gets its own step next.

room.title: Room: {room}
room.description: Pre-filled from the entity registry by area. Occupancy strength is derived from device class (occupancy and presence are strong, motion medium, sound weak, Bayesian sensors always strong) and can be overridden in the options. Sources named with 'person' are treated as camera person detection. {remaining} room(s) to go.

house.title: Whole house
house.description: Residents' device trackers and user ids are read from the person entities at runtime and re-read when they change.

data.calendar: Calendar for Sitter: and Service: events

csi_map.title: CSI sensor to door mapping
csi_map.description: For each CSI sensor pick the perimeter contact on the same door. CSI motion with no contact opening within 60 seconds scores the door_csi_motion rule.

house_deter.title: Trust, night and deterrence
house_deter.description: Trusted user ids are pre-filled from the residents' user ids plus any user named Presence Simulation. Changes by trusted users and by automations never score.

data.deter_sound: Deter sound (media URL or media-source id)
data.deter_tts_entity: Deter TTS entity (used instead of the sound)

responses.title: Responses
responses.description: Dry run stays on until you turn it off; every message is prefixed with [DRY RUN] and lists the actions that would have run.

data.digest_post_when_empty: Post the digest when nothing happened
data.dry_run: Dry run (describe actions instead of running them)
data.auto_alarm: Auto alarm (pulse the alarm trigger sensor)
data.notify_service_2: Second notify service for break-glass fan-out
data.mobile_notify_service: Mobile notify service for actionable labels
